tags.name: mth-button
tags.description: Action button with variant, size, and loading states.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Visual button emphasis.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Control size token scale.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables interaction.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Shows loading spinner and suppresses duplicate clicks.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Checked state.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Mixed visual and ARIA state.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Submitted form value when checked.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables checkbox interaction.

tags.name: mth-combobox
tags.description: Form-associated accessible combobox reconciling declarative `<mth-option>`/`<mth-option-group>`, `.options` JS arrays, and async `DataSource<T>` queries with same-root shadow ARIA and dual CSS Anchor / JS positioning.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name submitted via ElementInternals.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current selected value (comma-separated when `multiple` is true).

attributes.name: default-value
attributes.description: Initial value restored when the enclosing form resets.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible and accessible label for the combobox input.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Helper text describing expected input or options.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Explicit error message marking the combobox invalid.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Input placeholder text.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Controls visibility of the floating options popup.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Enables multi-value selection without dismissing on selection.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables interaction and excludes from form submission.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Marks combobox selection as required for constraint validation.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Prevents typing or changing selection while remaining focusable.

attributes.name: clearable
attributes.description: Shows a clear button when text or value is non-empty.

attributes.name: filterable
attributes.description: Filters local options dynamically as the user types.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred popup placement relative to the combobox control.

attributes.name: force-fallback
attributes.description: Forces JS fallback positioning instead of native CSS Anchor Positioning.

tags.name: mth-dialog
tags.description: Top-layer modal and non-modal dialog wrapping native `<dialog>` with default, alert, confirm, and prompt variants.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Controls open visibility of the dialog.

attributes.name: modal
attributes.description: Opens as modal top-layer dialog with backdrop and focus trap when true.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Built-in semantic dialog preset (`default | alert | confirm | prompt`).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible dialog title rendered in header.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional descriptive copy for alert/confirm/prompt dialogs.

attributes.name: prompt-value
attributes.description: Current input value when `variant="prompt"`.

attributes.name: close-on-escape
attributes.description: Allows dismissing the dialog via the Escape key.

tags.name: mth-error-boundary
tags.description: Captures errors / mth-error events from slotted subtree and presents a fallback with retry.

attributes.name: fallback-message
attributes.description: fallbackMessage

tags.name: mth-field
tags.description: Layout wrapper and Community Context Protocol provider for Methane form controls.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Field label text propagated to child controls via FieldContext.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Helper description text propagated via FieldContext.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Validation error message propagated via FieldContext.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Marks the field required and propagates via FieldContext.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables descendant Methane controls via FieldContext.

attributes.name: density
attributes.description: Density scale override for layout spacing.

tags.name: mth-input
tags.description: Form-associated textual input supporting FACE validation, same-root ARIA, FieldContext, and progressive Light-DOM autofill slot.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current string value.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form submission field name.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Semantic input type (`text | email | url | search | tel`).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible label rendered inside shadow root.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Helper text displayed and linked via aria-describedby inside shadow root.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Explicit custom error message displayed inside shadow root.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Hint displayed when empty.

attributes.name: autocomplete
attributes.description: HTML autocomplete token passed through to the underlying `<input>`.

attributes.name: inputmode
attributes.description: Virtual keyboard hint passed through to the underlying `<input>`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables user interaction.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Marks input required for constraint validation.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Prevents edits while remaining focusable and submittable.

tags.name: mth-option
tags.description: Selectable option item for `<mth-combobox>` and list containers.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Machine-readable value submitted when selected.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Optional explicit display label overriding slotted text content.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Prevents the option from being activated or selected.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Marks whether the option is currently selected.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Marks whether the option is currently highlighted via keyboard or pointer.

tags.name: mth-option-group
tags.description: Semantic option group container with heading label for `<mth-combobox>`.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible and accessible group heading label.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables all options nested inside the group.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: href

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Toggle state.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the switch.

tags.name: mth-visually-hidden
tags.description: Screen-reader-only utility element using logical CSS properties.
